sanskrit: paripṛcchatyumādevī ekānte jñānamuttamam kathayasva purābhedaṃ kulānandeṣu cottamam sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaṃ yathā dehe vyavasthitam sarvaṃ tattu sureśvara kathayasva mama prabho etat kaulikaṃ jñānaṃ kulānande cāṣṭottamaḥ tatraiva manasā rodhya lakṣayeddīpaśikhān vratī tena lakṣitamātreṇa jāyate siddhiruttamā tathā coparitiṣṭhati devo bhairavo jagatprabhuḥ jāyate dhvanibhirjātiṃ tatra marudviśeṣataḥ jāyate paramaṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryavicāraṇāt taṃ pravakṣyāmi he devi śṛṇuṣvāyatalocane tatraiva sthāpayedvittaṃ kathitaṃ jāyate dhruvam tatraivotpādayet sṛṣṭiṃ tīvrajyotiḥsamākṛtiḥ pāśastobhaṃ karotyevaṃ yadi viśramate manaḥ jvalajvālanamadhyasthaṃ dvijagranthi nirīkṣayet sṛṣṭiṃ pravartante devi nātra kāryavicāraṇāt kathayasva viśeṣeṇa yathā jānāmi tatkṣaṇāt brahmasthāne.....padmaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭidalānvitam bhedayitvā mahāgranthiṃ dvicakrañca tathaiva ca calantaṃ bhrāmayettena niyataṃ tu mahītale yāvadviśramate nityaṃ bhramate cakravat śiraḥ vāmasrotaṃ tu yāvat tīvratejasamaprabham etanme saṃśayo deva kathayasva mama prabho madhyataḥ palitāstambhayeddevi māsamekena suvrate

yatra catuṣpathasthānaṃ tatra sarvāsurālayam aśrutāṃ vadate bālāṃ...........ḍivya varānane tataḥ parataraṃ sthānaṃ tatra sarve pravartate jvalajjvalanasaṃdhyasthaṃ tatraiva lakṣayeddevi vedhayedvicakṣaṇaḥ vedhayitvā tu taṃ lakṣayet devāsuramanujānāṃ durlabho bhavati sādhakaḥ tataścāpi saṃśayo deva kathayasva mama prabho yā sā mahāvahā nāḍī kucelyākārasaṃsthitā hṛccakra............... tīvraśakti suvigrahā athānyaṃ paramaṃ devi khecaratvaṃ śṛṇu priye navāhamabhṛtaṃ dadaitaḥ (?) yāvad......ṣthāneṣu khyātā tasya mayāgrataḥ jvalanārūḍhaṃ kṛtvā caturthaṃ svarasaṃyutaḥ vargātītaṃ punardevi ṣaṣṭhasvaravibhūṣitaḥ vargasya prathamaṃ bījaṃ sṛṣṭerādyato yojayet nityaṃ tu yojayeddevi ekacittastu paṇḍitaḥ bhagasya madhyastha bhagamadho hutāśanam visantu cintayeddevi sṛṣṭikamalantu yāvat bhavanti vihvalā nāryaḥ kṣaṇamekena suvrate śṛṇuyāt paramādevi aghoravikramā tejasākarṣayet tu.....cittaṃ susaryataḥ saṃgamānmokṣahetukaṃ ................................. āsanaṃ tu sthitaṃ kṛtvā........viśva anivṛttaḥ cittaṃ tatra sthitaṃ kṛtvā khamadhye viniyojayet etadvijñānamātreṇa gīyate tatra madhyataḥ
